faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Tiruppur Child Help Desk Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must submit the application within 15 working days from the date of advertisement publication.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in Tiruppur District Child Protection Unit Recruitment?
faq.answer: Total 7 posts – 4 Supervisor and 3 Case Worker positions.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary for Supervisor post in Tiruppur Railway Child Help Desk?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will get a consolidated pay of Rs.21,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for Case Worker post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed 12th standard with good communication skills. Experience in helplines is preferred.

faq.answer: Maximum 42 years as on the date of notification.

faq.answer: Offline mode only. Submit the filled application with documents either by post or in person to the District Child Protection Officer, Tiruppur.

faq.answer: No. These are temporary contractual positions under the Department of Child Welfare and Special Services.

faq.answer: Self-attested copies of educational certificates, experience certificates, age proof, and other relevant documents along with the filled application form.
